$doc: Reusable BRAAM catalog (the big brass 'BRAAM' horn blast from trailers: weight and stakes). Sourced 2026-10-16 from Soundstripe on Mike's pick. Each source file held 3 takes, cut in silence into a/b/c; originals + Soundstripe metadata in ./_source/.
$schema_note: `mood_class` is the HARD-GATE mood (longform-edited.md section 7): dark = scary/ominous/horror, tense = suspense without dread, epic = big cinematic, hype = bright/energetic, neutral. Pick only a class that fits the chapter's register and music bed; never `dark` in an exciting/hype video. `mood_source` says how it was set: `description` = from the source page text, not yet confirmed by ear (Mike can correct). Takes cut from one multi-take source file share its source_id; their source_in/out are seconds in the original in _source/.

braams.title: Cinematic Braam Horn Stinger 02
braams.license: Soundstripe subscription, no Content-ID code for SFX (usage doc only); nothing to paste in a description.
braams.description: Sharp, punchy horn braam stinger, delivering a quick burst of energy and tension.
braams.character: big brass 'BRAAM' horn blast with a long low decay
braams.best_for: a heavy reveal, a stakes line, a big number landing; trailer-weight, so 1 or 2 per video at most. Take a hits fastest (peak ~0.5 s), b and c swell to the peak over ~1.6 s. PLACEMENT RULE (Mike 2026-10-17): BETWEEN sentences, never over a word: after an intense line, with the figures on screen, in a spine pause of the braam's audible length (take a ~4 s); EDIT-PLAN `[BRAAM] ... spine pause <dur> s at <s>`, longform-edited.md section 7
